SFixture: John 1, in the words of the WEB
Pm
V1
TIn the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
V2
TThe same was in the beginning with God.
V3
TAll things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
V4
TIn him was life, and the life was the light of men.
V5
TThe light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome
FThe word translated “overcome” (κατέλαβεν) can also be translated “comprehended.” It refers to getting a grip on an enemy to defeat him.
T it.
Pm
V6
TThere came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
V7
TThe same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
V8
THe was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
V9
TThe true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
Pm
V10
THe was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
V11
THe came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
V12
TBut as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
V13
Twho were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
Pm
V14
TThe Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born
FThe phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενους”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.
T Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
V15
TJohn testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
V16
TFrom his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
V17
TFor the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
F“Christ” means “Anointed One”.
V18
TNo one has seen God at any time. The only born
FThe phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.
T Son,
FNU reads “God”
T who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
Pm
V19
TThis is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
Pm
V20
THe declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
Pm
V21
TThey asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?”
Pm
THe said, “I am not.”
Pm
T“Are you the prophet?”
Pm
THe answered, “No.”
Pm
V22
TThey said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
Pm
V23
THe said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
Pm
V24
TThe ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
V25
TThey asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
Pm
V26
TJohn answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
V27
THe is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
V28
TThese things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
Pm
V29
TThe next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold,
F“Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
T the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
V30
TThis is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
V31
TI didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
V32
TJohn testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
V33
TI didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
V34
TI have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
Pm
V35
TAgain, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
V36
Tand he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
V37
TThe two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
V38
TJesus turned and saw them following, and said to them,
W “What are you looking for?”
Pm
TThey said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
Pm
V39
THe said to them,
W “Come and see.”
Pm
TThey came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
F4:00 p.m.
V40
TOne of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
V41
THe first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ
F“Messiah” (Hebrew) and “Christ” (Greek) both mean “Anointed One”.
T).
V42
THe brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said,
W “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas”
T (which is by interpretation, Peter).
F“Cephas” (Aramaic) and “Peter” (Greek) both mean “Rock”.
Pm
V43
TOn the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him,
W “Follow me.”
V44
TNow Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
V45
TPhilip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
Pm
V46
TNathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?”
Pm
TPhilip said to him, “Come and see.”
Pm
V47
TJesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him,
W “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
Pm
V48
TNathanael said to him, “How do you know me?”
Pm
TJesus answered him,
W “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
Pm
V49
TNathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
Pm
V50
TJesus answered him,
W “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
V51
THe said to him,
W “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
